_meta.description: This file contains a serialized version of schema entities for drift.

sql.sql: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "items" ("created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "id" TEXT NOT NULL, "type" TEXT NOT NULL, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "preset_id" TEXT NULL, "category_id" TEXT NULL, "account_id" TEXT NULL, "currency" TEXT NOT NULL, "cycle_unit" TEXT NOT NULL, "cycle_every" INTEGER NOT NULL, "anchor_on" TEXT NOT NULL, "paid_until" TEXT NULL, "status" TEXT NOT NULL, "status_since" TEXT NULL, "reminder_rules" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '[]', "type_fields" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}', "sharing" TEXT NULL, "note" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "price_phases" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "item_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES items (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "seq" INTEGER NOT NULL, "amount_minor" INTEGER NOT NULL, "length_kind" TEXT NOT NULL, "periods" INTEGER NULL, "until_on" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"), UNIQUE ("item_id", "seq"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "occurrences" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "item_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES items (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "cycle_index" INTEGER NOT NULL, "due_on" TEXT NOT NULL, "expected_minor" INTEGER NOT NULL, "currency" TEXT NOT NULL, "state" TEXT NOT NULL, "transaction_id" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"), UNIQUE ("item_id", "cycle_index"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "price_history" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "item_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES items (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "from_cycle_index" INTEGER NOT NULL, "effective_on" TEXT NOT NULL, "old_minor" INTEGER NOT NULL, "new_minor" INTEGER NOT NULL, "currency" TEXT NOT NULL, "recorded_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "accounts" ("created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "id" TEXT NOT NULL, "type" TEXT NOT NULL, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "currency" TEXT NOT NULL, "opening_balance_minor" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "credit_limit_minor" INTEGER NULL, "statement_day" INTEGER NULL, "payment_due_day" INTEGER NULL, "fx_fee_basis_points" INTEGER NULL, "archived" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("archived" IN (0, 1)), "sort_order" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "categories" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "parent_id" TEXT NULL, "kind" TEXT NOT NULL, "name" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', "builtin_key" TEXT NULL, "icon" TEXT NULL, "sort_order" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "exclude_from_work_income" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("exclude_from_work_income" IN (0, 1)), PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "transactions" ("created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "id" TEXT NOT NULL, "type" TEXT NOT NULL, "status" TEXT NOT NULL, "amount_minor" INTEGER NOT NULL, "currency" TEXT NOT NULL, "fx_rate" TEXT NULL, "fx_main_currency" TEXT NULL, "account_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES accounts (id), "to_account_id" TEXT NULL REFERENCES accounts (id), "to_amount_minor" INTEGER NULL, "category_id" TEXT NULL, "occurred_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "note" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', "occurrence_id" TEXT NULL, "is_adjustment" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("is_adjustment" IN (0, 1)), PRIMARY KEY ("id"));
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "tags" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "name" TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "transaction_tags" ("transaction_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES transactions (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "tag_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES tags (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, PRIMARY KEY ("transaction_id", "tag_id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "attachments" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "transaction_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES transactions (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "file_name" TEXT NOT NULL, "mime_type" TEXT NOT NULL, "size_bytes" INTEGER NOT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "aliases" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "preset_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "alias" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"), UNIQUE ("alias"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "reminder_log" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "item_id" TEXT NULL, "occurrence_id" TEXT NULL, "kind" TEXT NOT NULL, "scheduled_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "delivered_at" INTEGER NULL, "action" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "change_log" ("seq" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "entity" TEXT NOT NULL, "row_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "field" TEXT NOT NULL, "value" TEXT NOT NULL, "hlc" TEXT NOT NULL, "uploaded" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("uploaded" IN (0, 1)));
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "meta" ("key" TEXT NOT NULL, "value" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("key"));
CREATE INDEX change_log_row ON change_log (entity, row_id, field)
